starter_shell.description: Minimal committed baseline required in all repositories

root_files.README.md: Main project overview, getting started guidance, and navigation.
root_files.CONTRIBUTING.md: Contribution workflow, branch strategy, pull request expectations, coding expectations.
root_files.LICENSE_EE: Enterprise or commercial license terms, when the project uses a dual-license or enterprise-license model.
root_files.LICENSE_NOTICE.md: Human-readable summary of the repository's license structure and contact path.
root_files.SECURITY.md: Security policy, reporting process, and supported versions.
root_files.CHANGELOG.md: Notable changes by version or release.
root_files..gitignore: Files and folders excluded from version control.
root_files.AGENTS.md: Repository-wide agent-facing instructions and system of truth. Read by Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Claude Code (via the .claude/CLAUDE.md shim). Carries the synced shared-principles preamble block at the top; everything below it is repo-owned. See shared_standards for the synced block.
root_files.{project-name}.code-workspace: VS Code workspace file for opening the project root with shared workspace settings.

root_directories..github: GitHub-native workflows, Copilot instructions, prompts, agents, skills, templates.
root_directories..claude: Claude Code integration folder. Contains `CLAUDE.md` as a one-line `@../AGENTS.md` shim so Claude Code loads the repo-root AGENTS.md, plus a `skills/` symlink to `.agents/skills/` so reusable skills auto-load. Created at scaffold time; do not hand-author additional content here.
root_directories.docs: Documentation, standards, templates, decisions, references, and generated durable docs.
root_directories.bin: Runtime entry points, command-line tools, or executable wrappers.
root_directories.scripts: Development, build, setup, generation, and maintenance scripts.

github_structure..github/CODEOWNERS: Default ownership rules for repository paths and reviews.

agents_structure..agents/.gitkeep: Placeholder when .agents/ is intentionally scaffolded before it contains a reusable asset file.
agents_structure..agents/agents/.gitkeep: Placeholder when .agents/agents/ is intentionally scaffolded before it contains an agent file.
agents_structure..agents/skills/.gitkeep: Placeholder when .agents/skills/ is intentionally scaffolded before it contains a skill folder.

common_skills.source_path_note: The source stores skills in either location. Check both before reporting a skill as missing — agents-nexus-skills-manager currently lives under .agents/skills/, while the others live under skills/.

claude_code_integration.description: Claude Code discovers project skills under .claude/skills/. The repo standard keeps reusable skills under .agents/skills/ so they stay portable. To satisfy both without duplicating content, scaffold creates .claude/skills as a symlink (junction on Windows) pointing to ../.agents/skills.

.claude/skills.purpose: Expose reusable skills to Claude Code without moving them out of .agents/skills.
.claude/skills.windows_note: Created as a directory junction to avoid the admin/developer-mode requirement of NTFS symlinks.

shared_standards.description: Cross-project engineering standards. Kept identical across every repo and synced from the source repo below — do not hand-author or hand-edit these; edit the source and run the sync tool.

sync_tool.windows: scripts/sync-standards.ps1 (run as `sync-standards` from any directory when the alias is installed; also scans DevRoot for a multi-repo sweep)
sync_tool.linux_macos: scripts/sync-standards.sh --target-repo <path> (single-target only; use the .ps1 for the multi-repo sweep)

files..github/instructions/core-principles.ins: Think before acting; build for people; coherence.
files.AGENTS.md: Only the block between <!-- shared-principles:start --> and <!-- shared-principles:end --> markers is synced. Template source: ifoundry-development/docs/standards/ai/agents-md-shared-preamble.md. A repo with no AGENTS.md gets one created by the sync tool, carrying the block plus a placeholder Repository specifics section. Everything below the markers is repo-owned from then on. The `.claude/CLAUDE.md` one-line shim (`@../AGENTS.md`) is written by the scaffolder, not the sync tool; the repo-root CLAUDE.md is retired and never scaffolded.
